text:
review-library-supplement re-invocation: NO-OP.

The supplement pass already ran on this epic (verdict + confidence calibration filed 2026-05-14 14:28 UTC). Seven api-contract findings exist as JMAP-ayoz.22 through JMAP-ayoz.28, covering all six required subsections (immutability, underspecified, versioning, leakage, defensive, docs).

Verified the api-contract surface is unchanged since that pass:
- Diffed crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/ from supplement timestamp to HEAD: post-supplement commits touched src/metadata.rs and src/memory.rs only (handler bodies, MemoryBackend impl) — no changes to src/lib.rs or src/backend.rs (the pub-surface declarations).
- grep '^+.*\bpub\b' across all 11 post-supplement commits: zero new pub items introduced.

Per the workspace bikeshedding rule and review-loop convergence rule, filing additional api-contract findings on the unchanged surface would be manufactured noise. Stopping the supplement here is the correct outcome.

API contract risk verdict unchanged: MEDIUM (carried forward from the prior pass).
